contract: Transcribe actual canonical mono16bit PCM WAV8-48kHz<=60seconds with NumPy autocorrelation. Persist source reference, method, timing, detected notes and request fingerprint. Edit pitch36..96, velocity1..127, bounded timing with optimistic revision. Export real standard type0 MIDI as version-pinned canonical audio artifact. Exact API /api/capabilities/music/midi GET/POST, /{id} GET/PATCH, /{id}/export POST revision.
acceptance: Real pitch and timing vectors from authored PCM including silence and harmonic notes; no precomputed note substitution
Persistent idempotency, conflict detection, same-home source lookup and stale edit refusal
Interactive piano roll and editable note table, API/native consumers, canonical MIDI export parseable into expected note and tempo events
limits: Monophonic heuristic transcription; polyphonic mixtures, noisy or unpitched recordings have no accuracy guarantee and require review
No ML provider, new dependency installation or synthetic provider response
Audio-device playback and root browser integration remain separate

verification.scope: Real PCM pitch/rate/harmonic/silence/timing vectors; actual canonical MIDI byte parsing, SQLite/native/HTTP; two real HTTP UI journeys. Monophonic bounded scope only.
